title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Waiver of Room Reservations Deposit Handling Fees
content:
**Elite benefit schedule.** On the deposit handling fee charged when money held on a Room Reservations reservation is refunded after a no-show, a guest whose attached Ashbury Rewards membership holds the Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite tier with at least 50 elite night credits this year has the fee waived in full (100%); one whose membership holds the Platinum Elite or Gold Elite tier with at least 25 elite night credits has the middle share, 50%, of the fee waived; one holding the Silver Elite tier with at least 10 elite night credits has the silver share, 25%, waived; any other guest has no tier waiver (0%).

| Tier of the attached membership | Elite night credits this year | Share of the fee waived |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 50 or more | 100% |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 25 or more | 50% |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 10 or more | 25% |
| A tier below its own figure, Ashbury Rewards Member, or no membership attached | — | none |

The records read are the tier and the current calendar year's elite night credits of the Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation. Each tier group is held to its own figure, so a Platinum Elite member with 15 elite night credits receives no waiver.

The waiver takes its share off the fee charged on the refund, as that fee then stands, and before the fee is taken off the refund.

**Illustration (hypothetical fee charged of 45.00).** Ambassador Elite with 50 credits: nothing remains of the fee. Gold Elite with 30 credits: 22.50 remains. Silver Elite with 11 credits: 33.75 remains. Silver Elite with 9 credits: 45.00 remains.
